次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This ocean lies between Asia and the Americas. Japan faces it on its eastern side. It covers more area than any other ocean on our planet.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This ocean separates the Americas from Europe and Africa. Ships have crossed it for hundreds of years. The Titanic sank in its northern waters on a trip toward New York.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This sea lies between southern Europe and northern Africa. Italy and Greece have long coasts along it. It connects to the Atlantic through a narrow opening near Spain.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This salty lake lies between Jordan and the land to its west. Its water is so salty that people float easily. Despite its name, it is not an ocean or sea.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This lake is in Siberia in Russia. In winter, much of its surface freezes. It is the world's deepest lake and holds a very large amount of fresh water.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These powerful waterfalls lie between Canada and the United States. Visitors can ride boats near the falling water. One of the main falls has the shape of a horseshoe.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This huge valley is in the American state of Arizona. Its colorful rock walls show many layers. The Colorado River helped cut this deep opening over a very long time.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This huge natural area lies in the sea off northeastern Australia. It is made of many coral reefs. Colorful fish live here, and visitors explore the water by swimming or diving.
グレートバリアリーフ
グレートバリアリーフ

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This enormous rock stands in central Australia. Its color seems to change with the light. It is sacred to local Aboriginal people and was also known as Ayers Rock.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This very long structure crosses hills in northern China. Different rulers built and repaired its sections over many centuries. It was used to help defend the land from attacks.
ばんりのちょうじょう

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This white marble building stands in India. A ruler had it built in memory of his wife. It has a large central dome and a long pool in front.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This huge temple stands in Cambodia. Its towers appear on the country's flag. It was first built for a Hindu god and later became a place of Buddhist worship.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This iron tower stands beside a river in a European capital. It was built for a world fair in 1889. Today, it is one of the most famous sights in Paris.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This white tower is in Italy. It was built as a bell tower, but it began to lean because of the ground beneath it. Visitors often pretend to hold it up in photographs.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large ancient building stands in Rome. Crowds once sat around its central space to watch fights and other shows. Its stone walls have many rows of arches.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large green statue stands near New York Harbor. A woman holds a torch high in one hand. France gave it to the United States as a gift.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This ancient city stands high in the mountains of Peru. Stone walls and steps remain above green valleys. The Inca people built it, and clouds often cover the mountains around it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This ancient site is in southern England. Huge standing stones form a circle, with some stones resting across the tops. People still study why it was built thousands of years ago.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This church in Barcelona has tall towers and unusual shapes inspired by nature. Its building work began in the nineteenth century. The architect Antoni Gaudi devoted much of his life to it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This famous building stands beside an Australian harbor. Its white roofs look like large sails or shells. People go there to enjoy music and theater in the city of Sydney.
シドニーオペラハウス
シドニーオペラハウス

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Italian city is built on many small islands. Instead of ordinary roads, many routes are canals. Visitors ride long narrow boats called gondolas between its old buildings.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This European city has famous art museums and wide streets. A river called the Seine runs through it. The Eiffel Tower stands here, and it is the capital of France.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This city has a famous clock tower near its parliament buildings. Red double-decker buses run through its streets. The Thames flows through this capital of the United Kingdom.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This American city has many very tall buildings. People watch bright signs in Times Square and plays on Broadway. A large green park lies in the middle of Manhattan.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This group of islands is in the Pacific Ocean. Visitors enjoy warm beaches and volcanic scenery. It is an American state, and Honolulu is its capital city.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This remote island belongs to Chile but lies far out in the Pacific Ocean. It is famous for large stone figures with long faces. These statues are called moai.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Many people decorate trees for this December holiday. Children may wait for presents from a man in red. It is celebrated on December twenty-fifth in many countries.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Children wear scary or funny costumes for this event. They may visit homes and ask for sweets. Orange pumpkins with faces are common decorations on October thirty-first.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This holiday welcomes the beginning of a new year in Japan. Families may gather and visit a shrine. Children often receive money in small envelopes from their relatives.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
At this Japanese event, people throw roasted beans. They call for bad luck to leave and good luck to enter. Someone in the family may wear a demon mask.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Families display special dolls for this Japanese event. The dolls often sit on several red steps. People wish for girls to grow up healthy and happy on March third.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People write wishes on strips of colored paper for this event. They hang the paper on bamboo branches. Its story tells of two lovers who meet across a river of stars.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese holiday celebrates children on May fifth. Families may display a warrior's helmet inside the home. Outside, long fish-shaped flags swim in the wind above the ground.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Children dress nicely and visit shrines for this Japanese custom. Families pray for their healthy growth. The custom's name comes from the three ages of the children who take part.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People gather outside for this spring activity in Japan. Some bring food and sit on sheets under trees. The main purpose is to enjoy beautiful cherry blossoms together.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People enjoy the night sky during this autumn custom. They may display grass and round rice dumplings. The main thing they look at is the bright, round moon.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
During this Japanese summer custom, many people return to their hometowns. Families remember relatives who have died and visit graves. Some places hold dances to welcome the spirits of ancestors.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This is a special visit that many Japanese people make early in January. They go to a shrine or temple. It is their first such visit of the new year.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Japanese children look forward to receiving this at the new year. Adults usually put it in a small decorated envelope. It is money given as a holiday gift.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People send these cards to friends and relatives in Japan. They carry greetings for the beginning of the year. Many show the animal linked to that year in the traditional calendar.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These decorations stand near entrances around the Japanese new year. They often combine pine branches with cut bamboo. Their purpose is to welcome the god of the new year.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These long cloth decorations hang from a pole in Japan. Wind fills them, making them seem to swim. They look like carp and are displayed around Children's Day.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Visitors to Japanese shrines write wishes on these small wooden boards. One side often has a picture. People hang them at the shrine instead of taking them home.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You can get this small paper at a Japanese shrine or temple. It tells you about your luck. Its message may say that very good fortune is coming.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People buy this small item at shrines or temples in Japan. It is often kept in a little cloth bag. People carry it for protection or good luck.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This gate marks the entrance to a Japanese shrine. It usually has two posts and beams across the top. Many are painted red, but they have no doors.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People carry this decorated structure through streets during some Japanese festivals. Long poles support it on their shoulders. It is like a small shrine that can travel around the neighborhood.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People do this dance at summer events in Japan. They often move together in a circle around a raised platform. It is connected to a season for remembering ancestors.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This summer festival takes place in Aomori. Huge bright paper figures move through the streets at night. Dancers jump beside them while people play drums and flutes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This winter event takes place in Hokkaido's largest city. Artists make huge buildings and characters from snow and ice. Visitors walk through the cold streets to see these temporary works.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This famous festival takes place in Kyoto in July. Large decorated floats move through the streets. It has a long connection with Yasaka Shrine and prayers against illness.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This famous dance festival is strongly linked to Tokushima. Groups move through the streets with raised hands. A well-known saying calls both the dancers and the watchers fools.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This day is connected with love and falls in February. People may give cards, flowers, or sweets to someone special. In Japan, chocolate is a very common gift on the fourteenth.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This day comes one month after February's romantic gift day. In Japan, people often give a return gift to someone who gave them chocolate. It falls on March fourteenth.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
On this day, people thank the woman who raised them. Children may give flowers or make cards. In Japan, it is celebrated on the second Sunday in May.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
On this day, people may play harmless tricks on friends. Some companies also publish funny fake announcements. The date is the first day of the fourth month.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You start this Japanese art with a flat sheet. You fold it again and again without needing scissors. A crane is one of the best-known shapes you can make.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this Japanese art, people make beautiful characters on paper. They use black ink and a brush rather than a pencil. The shape and movement of each line matter.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this Japanese tradition, a host carefully prepares a drink for guests. Every movement has meaning. The drink is powdered green tea served in a bowl in a quiet room.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese art uses plants to create a balanced design. Flowers and branches are placed carefully in a container. Empty space is important, not just the number of colorful flowers.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People grow small trees in shallow pots for this art. They carefully cut and shape the branches. A finished tree may look like a full-sized old tree in miniature.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This short Japanese poem often includes a word about the season. Its traditional pattern has three parts. Those parts contain five, seven, and five sound units in Japanese.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese poem is longer than a haiku but still quite short. Its traditional form has five parts. Their sound counts are five, seven, five, seven, and seven.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This short Japanese poem often makes people smile about everyday life. Like a haiku, it usually follows a five-seven-five pattern. However, it does not need a seasonal word.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this Japanese performance, one person sits on a cushion. The performer plays several characters by changing voice and direction. A funny story usually ends with a clever final line.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this Japanese comedy style, two performers usually talk together on stage. One says strange or silly things. The other points out the mistakes, making the conversation funny.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This traditional Japanese theater uses dramatic poses and bright costumes. Actors may paint bold lines on their faces. Male actors traditionally play both men's and women's roles on stage.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This old Japanese theater often uses masks and slow movements. Singing and instruments support the story. Its wooden stage usually has a painting of a pine tree at the back.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This traditional Japanese theater tells stories with large puppets. Several people may work together to move one main puppet. A narrator tells the story while a three-stringed instrument plays.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This traditional Japanese theater often tells funny stories about ordinary people. It developed alongside noh, but uses more spoken dialogue. Servants and masters often appear in its simple comic scenes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These Japanese pictures became popular during the Edo period. Many were printed from carved wooden blocks. They often show actors, beautiful women, or famous landscapes such as Mount Fuji.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This painting style often uses only black ink and water. Different amounts of water create lighter and darker shades. Mountains and plants can appear without any bright colors.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese craft repairs broken pottery instead of throwing it away. The cracks are joined and often decorated with gold. The repaired lines become part of the object's beauty.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
In this art, people shape soft clay with their hands or a turning wheel. The pieces are heated in a special oven. Bowls, cups, and vases can be made this way.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This art makes objects that have height, width, and depth. Artists may cut stone or wood, or shape other materials. A statue of a person is one example.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These colorful pictures are made from pieces of glass. Light passes through them to show their colors. You often see them in the windows of old churches.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You sit in front of this large musical instrument. Pressing its black and white keys makes hammers hit strings inside. You can play both low and high notes with two hands.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This musical instrument usually has six strings and a long neck. You hold it against your body. One hand presses the strings while the other makes them sound.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You hold this small string instrument under your chin. A bow moves across its four strings. It often plays high melodies in an orchestra and has no keys.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This string instrument is too large to hold under your chin. You sit with it between your knees, and its pin touches the floor. A bow makes its four strings sing.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This very large string instrument often plays the lowest notes in an orchestra's string section. The player stands or sits on a tall stool. It is much taller than a cello.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You hold this wind instrument sideways near your mouth. You blow across a hole rather than through a reed. It is often silver-colored and makes clear, high sounds.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This brass instrument has a wide opening at one end. Players press three valves and blow with vibrating lips. Its bright sound is common in jazz and marching bands.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This brass instrument has a long part that moves in and out. The player slides it to change the notes. Its sound is often lower than a trumpet's.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This wind instrument is often made of shiny brass, but it uses a reed. Many versions have a curved shape. Its strong, warm sound is common in jazz.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This wind instrument is usually a straight black tube with silver keys. It uses one reed at the mouth. A famous children's song tells of one that has been broken.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This large musical instrument has many strings of different lengths. Its frame is often shaped like a triangle. The player uses fingers on both hands to make gentle sounds.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
The player holds this instrument in front of the body. Pulling and pushing its middle section moves air inside. Keys or buttons on the sides choose the notes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small musical instrument fits in your hands. You move it across your mouth and breathe in or out through its holes. Different holes produce different notes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Many Japanese children learn this wind instrument at school. They blow into its top and cover holes with their fingers. It is held straight down in front of the body.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small wind instrument often looks like a rounded sweet potato. Many are made of clay. You blow into a short mouthpiece and cover holes to change the notes.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small instrument looks like a tiny guitar but usually has four strings. Its cheerful sound is strongly linked to Hawaii. You can hold it easily against your chest.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese instrument has a long neck and three strings. Players often use a large pick to strike them. Its sound accompanies traditional songs and puppet theater.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This long Japanese string instrument lies in front of the player. The common kind has thirteen strings stretched over small bridges. Players use picks attached to their fingers.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This traditional Japanese flute is usually made from bamboo. The player holds it downward and blows across its top edge. Its name comes from a traditional measurement of length.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese instrument has a stretched skin over a wooden body. Players hit it with thick sticks. Large versions make powerful sounds at festivals and stage performances.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This small percussion instrument has a round frame with metal pieces around it. You can shake it or hit it with your hand. It makes a bright jingling sound.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This percussion instrument is made from a metal rod bent into three sides. One corner is left open. You hang it from a string and strike it with another metal rod.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These small percussion instruments have two hard pieces that click together. Schoolchildren often hold a simple pair in one hand. More advanced versions are used in Spanish dance.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This instrument has wooden bars arranged from low notes to high notes. Players hit the bars with small mallets. Longer bars usually make lower sounds than shorter ones.
